site_name: Land north and east of Stainrigg Mains Farm (The Laundry Field)
address: North and East of Stainrigg Mains Farm, Coldstream

site_area_m2.notes: Reported as 69 hectares of greenfield land

gross_floor_area_m2.notes: Reported as 'up to 70,000 sqm of data centre buildings'; unclear whether footprint or gross floor area

land_notes: Gently sloping arable land rising from the southern boundary and falling to the Laprig Burn at the northern boundary. Council screening found no Sites of Special Scientific Interest within a 5 km radius likely to be affected. Coordinates are an approximate centroid offset north-east of Stainrigg Mains farmstead (Nominatim: 55.6808, -2.3551); no red-line plan was retrievable, so precision is honest-approximate. The site sits roughly 5 km north of the River Tweed, which forms the England border at Coldstream; the Till valley lies across the border in Northumberland, and the scheme drew coverage in the Northumberland press.
